description: Provides REST APIs to manage Squarespace commerce data such as orders, products, inventory, and transactions.
blocker_details: Documentation does not specify the exact authentication mechanism (e.g., OAuth2, API key) or the access tier required to obtain API credentials, making integration uncertain.
evidence_excerpts: All Commerce APIs are built on HTTPS and designed with REST principles in mind.
Authentication for Commerce APIs also provides permissions to keep Squarespace merchant site data private and secure.
Read and write orders, products, inventory, and transactions. REST endpoints, webhooks for order events, and signed payloads for safe server-to-server delivery.
